stem: Which sentence from the article best expresses the cactus wren’s experience in the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: The cholla cactus also provides tasty meals for many other desert animals.

options.label: G
options.text: Many animals also seek shelter from the scorching sun.

options.label: H
options.text: While the desert may seem virtually uninhabitable, it is home to many animals and plants.

options.label: J
options.text: The cholla cactus not only survives in the desert but also helps animals live comfortably in this extreme environment.
